SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. I. O. D..194...
Date...3...7...29...

July 1, 29.

My dear Jamieson,

I have to acknowledge with thanks receipt
of your letter of March 11, forwarding an anonymous
letter on the subject of one Yang Ah Mau (楊阿毛),
who is wanted in connection with the murder by shooting
which occurred outside the Sun Sun Company building
on March 4, 1929. The matter dealt with in that
letter has already been receiving attention of the
Police, but unfortunately their efforts to trace
Yang Ah Mau have not so far proved successful. It,
however, gives me satisfaction to be able to inform
you that five of his accomplices in this dastardly
crime have been arrested and sentenced to various
terms of imprisonment.

I return the anonymous letter herewith.

Yours sincerely,

(Sd) R.M.J. Martin.

E. O. Jamieson, Esq., C.B.E.,
H.B.M. Consulate General,
Shanghai.

Anonymous letter
returned to H. B. M.
Consulate. 2.7.
B. Y. Lee

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事侦缉处登记室
编号 I. O. D..194...
日期...29...年7...月3...日...

1929年7月1日。

亲爱的詹姆森：

谨此致谢，收悉您3月11日来信，转来一封匿名信，内容涉及一名叫杨阿毛（楊阿毛）的人，此人因涉及1929年3月4日发生在先施公司大楼外的枪击谋杀案而被通缉。该信所述事项已受到警方关注，但不幸的是，迄今追踪杨阿毛的努力尚未成功。然而，令我感到欣慰的是，能够告知您，在此卑鄙罪行中，他的五名同伙已被逮捕并判处不同程度的监禁。

现随函退回该匿名信。

此致
敬礼，

（签名）R.M.J. 马丁

E. O. 詹姆森 阁下，C.B.E.勋衔，
英国驻上海总领事馆，
上海。

匿名信
已退回英国
总领事馆。7月2日
B. Y. Lee

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. D. 106.
REPORT
Louza Station,
Date 27th June 1929
Subject (in full). Report re attached letter.
Made by D.S.I. White Forwarded by [Signature]
Sir,
I herewith return letter received from one M.D.Chen, per
offices of the British Consulate-General re the case of Yang
Ah Mau (杨阿毛), who is wanted re the shooting and murder
at Sun Sun Co's building on 4-2-29.
The letter, which is one of a great number received,
anonymous, was attended to and inquiries instituted, but with
no favourable results.
The man Yang Ah Mau is still at large; Five others were
sentenced, one to life-imprisonment and four to five years each.
Claude White.
D. S. I.
Misc.
No further action
for the Union of their
acquittal.
25/6
[Signature]
Supt. B Division.
W.M.

his letter. Aca

BRITISH CONSULATE-GENERAL,
SHANGHAI.

11th March 1929.

My dear Barrett,

I send you in original a letter we
have received from a certain Mr. M.D.Chen which
may possibly be of interest to you. Will you
let me have it back please in due course?

Yours sincerely,

E.G. Jamieson

Captain E.I.M.Barrett, C.I.E.,
Commissioner,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
